title: CORDICan — Corpus Documental de las Islas Canarias
notes: Digital edition of Canary Islands documentation from the 16th to the 19th century (private and public documents generated in or about the islands), developed by the LexHis group (projects FFI2016-76154-P, ProID2020010097 and others) in the TEITOK platform (also reachable at http://teitok.cordican.ull.es/); raw TEI served per document. The TEITOK projects list gives an indicative size of 16 docs / 17k tokens (checked 2026-11-05) for the whole corpus, which spans the 16th-19th centuries; the share dated within 1450-1700 has not been established, so no in-window count is recorded. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.11 (texts harvested from this resource in November 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No licence terms stated on the corpus page; funded by Spanish and Canary Islands public programmes.
